items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played the Meridien Hotel, La Petit Journal. They liked me in Paris

ctx.x: I don’t know. ‘Cause they only had one Josephine Baker. I guess Paris thought that was enough.
Have you ever played there, Paris?
Oh sure. I played the Meridien Hotel, La Petit Journal. They liked me in Paris, but they make you play…
